This Writ Petition has been filed for the issue of writ of mandamus forbearing the respondents from putting up a drainage in the patta land belonging to the petitioner without following due process of law.
2.When this writ petition came up for hearing on 21.04.2021, a request was made on the side of the respondents to file counter.
This Court while adjourning the case, directed the respondents not to put up the drainage in the patta land belonging to the petitioner.
3.When the matter was taken up for hearing on 16.10.2023, this Court passed the following order:

When the matter was taken up for hearing today, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that in total disregard to the interim order passed by this Court on 21.04.2021, the fifth respondent has proceeded to put up a drainage in the Patta land belonging to the petitioner.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
2.The learned Additional Government Pleader is directed to take instructions in this regard.

3.Post this case under the caption for orders on 19.10.2023 4.When the matter is taken up for hearing today, the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents submitted that the drainage was not laid in the patta land belonging to the petitioner.
It was laid only in the place, which has been earmarked as 'Pathai' in the revenue records.
The relevant documents were also produced before this Court along with photographs.

5.In view of the above, it is clear that laying of the drainage has already been completed and it has been done only in the land belonging to the Government and therefore, the apprehension raised by the petitioner no longer sustains.

Accordingly,
this Writ Petition is disposed of.
No costs.
